question: 2026 kitap bazında satış tutarı ilk 10
referenceSQL: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.NAME label,l.LINENET value FROM dbo.LG_211_01_STLINE l JOIN dbo.LG_211_ITEMS p ON p.LOGICALREF=l.STOCKREF WHERE l.DATE_ >= '20260101' AND l.DATE_ < '20270101' AND l.CANCELLED=0 AND l.LINETYPE=0 AND l.TRCODE IN (7,8) UNION ALL SELECT p.NAME label,l.LINENET value FROM dbo.LG_411_01_STLINE l JOIN dbo.LG_411_ITEMS p ON p.LOGICALREF=l.STOCKREF WHERE l.DATE_ >= '20260101' AND l.DATE_ < '20270101' AND l.CANCELLED=0 AND l.LINETYPE=0 AND l.TRCODE IN (7,8)) SELECT TOP 10 label,SUM(value) value FROM sales GROUP BY label ORDER BY value DESC
sql:
SELECT TOP 10 ITEMS.[NAME] AS kitap, SUM(STLINE.[LINENET]) AS satis_tutar
FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINENET], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS]) AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] AND STLINE.[__nb_firm] = ITEMS.[__nb_firm]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[NAME]
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC

question: 411 firmasında Ocak 2026 için müşteri, ürün, ödeme planı, satış temsilcisi, teslimat şehri ve birim bazında satılan adet göster.
referenceSQL:
SELECT C.DEFINITION_ AS d0,I.NAME AS d1,P.DEFINITION_ AS d2,R.DEFINITION_ AS d3,H.CITY AS d4,U.NAME AS d5,SUM(S.AMOUNT) AS adet FROM dbo.LG_411_01_STLINE S
JOIN dbo.LG_411_ITEMS I ON S.STOCKREF=I.LOGICALREF
JOIN dbo.LG_411_01_INVOICE F ON S.INVOICEREF=F.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_CLCARD C ON F.CLIENTREF=C.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_PAYPLANS P ON COALESCE(NULLIF(S.PAYDEFREF,0),F.PAYDEFREF)=P.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_SLSMAN R ON F.SALESMANREF=R.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_SHIPINFO H ON F.SHIPINFOREF=H.LOGICALREF
LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_UNITSETL U ON S.UOMREF=U.LOGICALREF
WHERE S.CANCELLED=0 AND S.LINETYPE=0 AND S.TRCODE IN(7,8)
AND S.DATE_ >= '2026-01-01' AND S.DATE_ < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY C.DEFINITION_,I.NAME,P.DEFINITION_,R.DEFINITION_,H.CITY,U.NAME
sql:
SELECT UNITSETL.[NAME] AS bir, SHIPINFO.[CITY] AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_] AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_] AS odem_pla, ITEMS.[NAME] AS urun, CLCARD.[DEFINITION_] AS muster, SUM(STLINE.[AMOUNT]) AS satilan_adet
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE] AS STLINE
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_UNITSETL] AS UNITSETL ON STLINE.[UOMREF] = UNITSETL.[LOGICALREF]
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE ON STLINE.[INVOICEREF] = INVOICE.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_SHIPINFO] AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE.[SHIPINFOREF] = SHIPINFO.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_SLSMAN] AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE.[SALESMANREF] = SLSMAN.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_PAYPLANS] AS PAYPLANS ON PAYPLANS.[LOGICALREF] = COALESCE(NULLIF(STLINE.[PAYDEFREF], 0), INVOICE.[PAYDEFREF])
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS] AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_CLCARD] AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL.[NAME], SHIPINFO.[CITY], SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_], PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_], ITEMS.[NAME], CLCARD.[DEFINITION_]
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
physicalSql: SELECT UNITSETL.[NAME] AS bir, SHIPINFO.[CITY] AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_] AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_] AS odem_pla, ITEMS.[NAME] AS urun, CLCARD.[DEFINITION_] AS muster, SUM(STLINE.[AMOUNT]) AS satilan_adet FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE] AS STLINE LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_UNITSETL] AS UNITSETL ON STLINE.[UOMREF] = UNITSETL.[LOGICALREF] JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE ON STLINE.[INVOICEREF] = INVOICE.[LOGICALREF] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_SHIPINFO] AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE.[SHIPINFOREF] = SHIPINFO.[LOGICALREF] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_SLSMAN] AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE.[SALESMANREF] = SLSMAN.[LOGICALREF] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_PAYPLANS] AS PAYPLANS ON PAYPLANS.[LOGICALREF] = COALESCE(NULLIF(STLINE.[PAYDEFREF], 0), INVOICE.[PAYDEFREF]) JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS] AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_CLCARD] AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF] WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0 AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0 AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0 AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8) AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY UNITSETL.[NAME], SHIPINFO.[CITY], SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_], PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_], ITEMS.[NAME], CLCARD.[DEFINITION_] ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
